The trace simulates the listed population opponents (always C, TFT-like, random defectors, etc.) and plans a rewrite with probing, retaliation detection, exploitation of naive cooperators, and endgame defection.

It changes the parent's d_opp==0 branch to probe/defect more aggressively, then tests that modification against slot 5.

We can modify the parent to include this early test instead of the initial C,C,C... The parent currently starts with C and uses complex heuristics."
STRATEGY: The parent is a long adaptive/TFT-style policy with cooperation, probing, forgiveness, and endgame logic. The trace simulates the parent and a modified version against slots 5, 6, TFT, always-C, and always-D, then designs a new strategy with an early consecutive-defection test at rounds 10–12 and a forgiving TFT afterward. It changes the opening from pure cooperation to C,C,C,C,C,C,C,C,C,C,D,D,C and adds exploit mode if the opponent cooperates at round 12.
